notes.mtSummary: MT: מעמל נפשו יראה ישבע — verb 'see' with no object 'light'.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵃ has the servant see light (אור) after anguish — a life/vindication idiom absent from MT.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Ulrich, Biblical Qumran Scrolls (BQS), Isaiah 53:11 apparatus
Tov, Text of Isaiah at Qumran; Text and Canon Institute Isa 53:11 collation

notes.mtSummary: MT lacks אור; even proto-MT-leaning 1QIsaᵇ here joins the plus.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵇ (usually close to MT) and 4QIsaᵈ also read 'see light,' strengthening the non-MT plus.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Ferguson, Text & Canon: Servant Who Sees Light

notes.mtSummary: MT: למספר בני ישראל — 'according to the number of the sons of Israel'.
notes.dssSummary: 4QDeutʲ reads 'sons of God' (בני אלוהים), aligning with LXX angels/sons of God against MT 'sons of Israel'.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

anchor.note: Verse-level literary; MT shorter Song ending vs 4QDeutᵍ fuller cola

notes.mtSummary: MT four cola: הרנינו גוים עמו … דם עבדיו … ולא משנאיו line absent; no 'heavens/gods' opening.
notes.dssHebrew: הרנינו שמים עמו והשתחוו לו כל אלהים כי דם בניו יקום … ולמשנאיו ישלם ויכפר אדמת עמו
notes.dssSummary: 4QDeutᵍ preserves a longer ending (heavens + all gods worship; blood of his sons; repay haters) closer to LXX than short MT.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

anchor.note: Verse-level plus after mem-line (v.13); samekh-line is v.14 in MT numbering

notes.mtSummary: MT acrostic skips nun between mem (v.13) and samekh (v.14).
notes.dssHebrew: נאמן אלוהים בדבריו וחסיד בכול מעשיו
notes.dssSummary: 11QPsᵃ (and LXX) supply the missing nun-line: God is faithful in his words and gracious in all his works.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: BHS/BHQ apparatus Ps 145:13 (1 Heb MS + G S)

anchor.note: Edition-level: MT vv.6–8 (+10) absent from shorter tradition; do not claim verse-by-verse without cite

notes.mtSummary: MT Jer 10 includes hymnic vv.6–8 (and v.10) amid the idol satire; longer edition overall (~15% longer than OG).
notes.dssSummary: Hebrew fragments 4QJerᵇ/ᵈ align with the shorter LXX-like edition of Jeremiah (arrangement + omissions), not a verse dump of every plus.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Tov, large-scale differences LXX/MT (Jeremiah edition I vs II)
Ulrich BQS Jeremiah; Janzen, Studies in the Text of Jeremiah

anchor.note: High-level edition pointer near idol pericope; MT base unchanged

notes.mtSummary: MT Jeremiah is the longer, rearranged edition (incl. Oracles Against the Nations placement).
notes.dssSummary: Treat Qumran short Jeremiah as an alternate ancient edition (with OG), not as replacing OSHB verse text.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Tov, Textual Criticism of the Hebrew Bible (Jeremiah editions)
Oxford Handbook of Jeremiah — Two Ancient Editions

anchor.note: Language seam: Hebrew narrative → Aramaic speech; DSS preserve bilingual book

notes.mtSummary: MT shifts to Aramaic at 2:4b after the cue אֲרָמִית; continues Aramaic through 7:28.
notes.dssSummary: Qumran Daniel MSS preserve the same Hebrew→Aramaic seam at 2:4 as MT (not inventing phonetics).
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

anchor.note: Return to Hebrew after Aramaic block 2:4b–7:28; 4QDanᵃ spans 7:28–8:1

notes.mtSummary: MT resumes Hebrew at 8:1 after Aramaic chs. 2–7.
notes.dssSummary: DSS Daniel confirms the Aramaic→Hebrew return at 8:1; seam is structural, not a single substituted lexeme.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

notes.mtSummary: MT: ויקרא אריה — 'and a lion called'.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵃ reads הראה ('the seer/watcher'), fitting the watchman context better than MT אריה 'lion'.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Parry, Exploring the Isaiah Scrolls and Their Textual Variants (Isa 21:8)

notes.mtSummary: MT: מהרו בניך — 'your sons hurry'.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵃ reads בוניך 'your builders' (rebuild Zion), a sense change from MT בניך 'your sons'.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

notes.mtSummary: MT: גבהו שש אמות וזרת — six cubits and a span.
notes.dssSummary: 4QSamᵃ (with LXX) reads four cubits and a span, not MT six — a clear numerical sense change.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Hays, JETS 48 (2005) 'Reconsidering the Height of Goliath'

notes.mtSummary: MT: וישב שם עד עולם — dwell there forever (no explicit נזיר).
notes.dssSummary: 4QSamᵃ makes Samuel’s lifelong dedication explicitly Nazirite (נזיר), clarifying MT’s 'forever' vow.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Ulrich, Qumran Text of Samuel and Josephus
NOTE: consonants widely cited; confirm lineation in DJD plates before ship:true

anchor.note: 1QIsaᵃ originally shorter in 40:7–8 area (aligns with LXX shortness); later hand supplements — literary/minus

notes.mtSummary: MT has full 'grass withers… breath of YHWH blows… surely people are grass' sequence into v.8.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵃ’s first hand is shorter in 40:7–8 (with LXX); a later scribe filled toward MT — flag as growth, not orthography.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Scholarly notes on 1QIsaᵃ second-hand supplement at 40:7

notes.mtSummary: MT: כי דם עבדיו יקום — blood of his servants.
notes.dssSummary: 4QDeutᵍ reads 'blood of his sons' (בניו) where MT has 'servants' (עבדיו) — related demythologizing pattern as 32:8.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: McCarthy BHQ; van der Kooij on Deut 32:43

anchor.note: Literary plus between 10:27 and 11:1 in 4QSamᵃ (Nahash episode); verse-level

notes.mtSummary: MT jumps from scorn of Saul (10:27) to Nahash besieging Jabesh (11:1) without the 4QSamᵃ bridge narrative.
notes.dssSummary: 4QSamᵃ preserves a longer Nahash/Jabesh lead-in absent from MT — edition-like narrative plus (see DJD XVII).
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Cross, 'The Ammonite Oppression' / Ulrich Samuel studies

notes.mtSummary: MT: כי אתה יהוה לבדך — 'for you YHWH alone'.
notes.dssSummary: 1QIsaᵃ expands to 'you are God alone' (הוא אלהים) — sense-clarifying plus vs shorter MT; CONFIRM lineation in DJD XXXII.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: UNCERTAIN exact spacing/wording — Sofer must verify plate before ship:true

anchor.note: Samekh-line; nun-line belongs between 13 and 14 — cross-ref dss-ps-145-nun-a

notes.mtSummary: MT v.14 begins samekh (סומך) immediately after mem-line.
notes.dssHebrew: נאמן אלוהים בדבריו וחסיד בכול מעשיו
notes.dssSummary: Learner cue: the Qumran/LXX nun-line sits just before this samekh verse.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text

anchor.note: MT verse absent from shorter OG/4QJer tradition — category minus relative to short edition, shown as literary

notes.mtSummary: MT Jer 10:10 hymnic 'YHWH is true God…' present in long edition.
notes.dssSummary: Short Jeremiah (OG + 4QJerᵇ/ᵈ pattern) lacks this MT verse among the 10:6–8,10 expansions — edition difference.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
refs: Janzen; Tov on Jer 10 short vs long

notes.mtSummary: MT בני ישראל.
notes.dssSummary: Some scholars reconstruct an earlier בני אל behind בני אלוהים/LXX; treat as uncertain alternate, not ship-ready alone.
notes.disclaimer: Does not replace the Masoretic/OSHB text
